events.title: Can PNC's Record Capital Markets Pace Support Its Fee-Income Outlook?
events.summary: PNC Financial Services Group is experiencing strong growth in its fee businesses, especially capital markets, which is on track for a record year due to robust M&A activity and advisory services. The company has expanded its capabilities through acquisitions and cross-selling, leading to an increased outlook for non-interest income growth. Other major banks like Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan are also benefiting from the improved M&A environment.

articles.headline: Can PNC's Record Capital Markets Pace Support Its Fee-Income Outlook?

events.title: JPMorgan Sees ‘Nothing Flashing Red’ In US Economy
events.summary: JPMorgan's Commercial & Investment Bank co-president, Doug Petno, stated that the bank anticipates strong third-quarter investment banking fees and markets revenue, with broad-based strength across the division. Petno indicated that JPMorgan sees "nothing flashing red" in the U.S. economy, although it monitors some weakness among companies serving lower-income consumers and those vulnerable to AI disruption. He also noted a return to normal for private equity activity, but expressed caution regarding some 2019-2021 vintage investments and the private credit market.

articles.headline: JPMorgan Sees ‘Nothing Flashing Red’ In US Economy

events.title: ConocoPhillips Stock Falls as Oil Prices Retreat
events.summary: ConocoPhillips (NYSE: COP) shares dropped due to retreating crude prices, driven by eased Saudi supply concerns and a smaller-than-expected drawdown in U.S. crude inventories. Brent and WTI crude prices fell significantly after reports of Saudi Arabia rerouting oil to Asia and the Energy Information Administration disclosing a modest reduction in domestic stockpiles. This combination of factors made ConocoPhillips one of the weakest performers among oil and gas exploration companies.

articles.headline: ConocoPhillips Stock Falls as Oil Prices Retreat

events.title: J.B. Hunt shares fall Wednesday after company warns of third quarter profit decline
events.summary: J.B. Hunt Transport Services Inc. shares dropped 13% after the company warned of a 5% to 10% decline in third-quarter profits due to erratic fuel costs and increased driver expenses. Despite strong demand across segments, particularly in intermodal services, higher diesel costs and driver recruitment bonuses are expected to negatively impact the bottom line. The company noted that fuel surcharges might offset some costs, but rapid fuel price shifts make it difficult for the formula to keep pace.

articles.headline: J.B. Hunt shares fall Wednesday after company warns of third quarter profit decline

events.title: NextEra Energy (NEE) Stock Looks Fairly Priced As Merger Approval Looms Large
events.summary: NextEra Energy's stock appears fairly priced according to a Dividend Discount Model, which values the company based on its dividend stream. The valuation considers recent dividends, payout ratio, and a projected long-term dividend growth rate of 3.7%, acknowledging the significant impact of the approved US$66.8 billion merger with Dominion Energy on future cash flows and payout capacity. The article also highlights bull and bear cases for NEE's future valuation, focusing on factors like demand growth from AI and data centers versus potential risks from phasing out tax credits and increased regulation.

articles.headline: NextEra Energy (NEE) Stock Looks Fairly Priced As Merger Approval Looms Large

events.title: Oil Producers Slide as Crude Retreats: EOG Resources Drops 6%, ConocoPhillips and Occidental Petroleum Fall 5%
events.summary: Oil and gas producers, including EOG Resources, ConocoPhillips, and Occidental Petroleum, experienced significant stock drops as crude oil prices retreated. The sector-wide decline is attributed directly to falling crude prices, impacting exploration and production companies that own the barrels they sell, rather than any company-specific news. Despite the recent downturn, ConocoPhillips remains up 7% over the past month, suggesting the current slide is a partial pullback rather than a fundamental shift in business outlook.

articles.headline: Oil Producers Slide as Crude Retreats: EOG Resources Drops 6%, ConocoPhillips and Occidental Petroleum Fall 5%

events.title: Rail News - South Carolina Gov. McMaster voices support for UP-NS merger. For Railroad Career Professionals
events.summary: South Carolina Governor Henry McMaster has sent a letter to the Surface Transportation Board expressing support for the proposed merger between Union Pacific Railroad and Norfolk Southern Railway. McMaster highlighted the importance of a robust freight transportation network for South Carolina's economic growth and believes the merger will strengthen the state's role in commerce. Norfolk Southern's President and CEO, Mark George, thanked McMaster, noting that the merger will expand access to western markets and reinforce South Carolina's position as a global trade gateway.

articles.headline: Rail News - South Carolina Gov. McMaster voices support for UP-NS merger. For Railroad Career Professionals

events.title: Valero Energy stock hits all-time high at 400.2 USD
events.summary: Valero Energy's stock has reached an all-time high of $400.14, marking a 149.3% increase over the past year. This growth is attributed to strategic initiatives and favorable market conditions, with the company's financial health rated as "GREAT" by InvestingPro. Analysts from UBS and TD Cowen have raised their price targets for Valero, reflecting confidence in its refining margins and strong performance.

articles.headline: Valero Energy stock hits all-time high at 400.2 USD

events.title: Arabica Futures Jump to 13-Year Highs Amid Supply Concerns
events.summary: Arabica coffee futures have reached 13-year highs, driven by supply concerns due to dry and hot weather forecasts in Brazil's main coffee-growing regions. This surge comes as damage to the 2025-2026 crop is already anticipated, coinciding with high demand for Arabica due to Robusta shortages and rising prices. A softer US dollar is providing additional support, though traders attribute the rally primarily to fundamental supply issues.

articles.headline: Arabica Futures Jump to 13-Year Highs Amid Supply Concerns

events.title: Why Is Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) in Focus as Yields Rise?
events.summary: Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) is under market scrutiny as rising oil costs and Treasury yields, coupled with an impending Federal Reserve decision, influence trading. The company, part of the communication stocks sector, is being evaluated not just on its operational execution and customer demand, but also within the broader context of technology sector pressure versus energy sector gains. The article emphasizes that while macroeconomic factors create market volatility, Alphabet's long-term relevance hinges on its ability to manage competitive landscapes, adapt to changing consumer preferences, and maintain robust operational coordination.

articles.headline: Why Is Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) in Focus as Yields Rise?

events.title: FG Nexus Board of Directors Approves Affordable Housing Real Estate Acquisition Strategy and $10 Million Investment in FG Communities
events.summary: FG Nexus Inc. has approved a strategy to acquire affordable housing communities and will invest $10 million in FG Communities, a privately held real estate company focused on manufactured housing. This move signifies FG Nexus's transition into a real estate operating company specializing in land-lease affordable housing, with plans to change its name to FG Communities Holdings, Inc. and its stock ticker symbols. The company aims to address a large and fragmented affordable housing market in the U.S., leveraging FG Communities' operating platform.

articles.headline: FG Nexus Board of Directors Approves Affordable Housing Real Estate Acquisition Strategy and $10 Million Investment in FG Communities

events.title: IDEXX Laboratories Acquires CoVetAI to Advance Veterinary Workflow Intelligence
events.summary: IDEXX Laboratories, a leader in pet healthcare innovation, has acquired CoVetAI Inc., a company specializing in AI-native ambient listening and clinical workflow software for veterinary practices. This acquisition aims to enhance efficiency, clinical decision-making, and diagnostic utilization by integrating CoVet's technology into IDEXX's existing software ecosystem. The move strengthens IDEXX's commitment to leveraging AI to improve veterinary workflow and patient care globally.

articles.headline: IDEXX Laboratories Acquires CoVetAI to Advance Veterinary Workflow Intelligence

events.title: First Solar to Withdraw Section 337 Complaint After Recent US Section 232 Action on Polysilicon, Derivatives
events.summary: First Solar announced its intention to withdraw a Section 337 complaint following recent US Section 232 action on polysilicon and its derivatives. This decision comes after the US Commerce Department finalized steep duties on solar imports from India, Indonesia, and Laos. The article also includes recent analyst ratings and price target adjustments for First Solar.

articles.headline: First Solar to Withdraw Section 337 Complaint After Recent US Section 232 Action on Polysilicon, Derivatives

events.title: Why is Union Pacific stock rallying today? By Investing.com
events.summary: Union Pacific (UNP) stock rallied 2.3% in pre-market trading after UBS upgraded the railroad giant from Neutral to Buy, raising its price target to $339 from $310. The upgrade was driven by expectations of compelling volume growth, particularly in intermodal, and earnings estimates significantly above Wall Street consensus. Additional factors contributing to the rally include an upcoming management presentation at a Morgan Stanley conference and the ongoing proposed merger with Norfolk Southern.

articles.headline: Why is Union Pacific stock rallying today? By Investing.com

events.title: Dollar General Sees Shopper Pressure Persisting, Bets on Value and Delivery Growth
events.summary: Dollar General anticipates continued pressure on shoppers through late 2026 due to inflation and high fuel costs, leading customers to make more frequent but smaller purchases. In response, the company is focusing on value offerings, expanding its delivery services, and aiming for long-term targets of 2-3% same-store sales growth and 6-7% operating margin by 2028. CEO Todd Vasos plans to step down in January 2027, with JJ Fleeman named as his successor.

articles.headline: Dollar General Sees Shopper Pressure Persisting, Bets on Value and Delivery Growth

events.title: Why is Union Pacific stock rallying today?
events.summary: Union Pacific (UNP) stock is rallying today following an upgrade from UBS, which raised its rating from Neutral to Buy and increased its price target to $339 from $310. The upgrade is driven by a compelling volume growth thesis and earnings estimates significantly above Wall Street consensus. Additionally, CEO Jim Vena and CFO Jennifer Hamann are presenting at the Morgan Stanley 14th Annual Laguna Conference, contributing to increased investor attention.

articles.headline: Why is Union Pacific stock rallying today?

events.title: AJB Investment Fund II acquires $17,150 of Jewett Cameron Trading stock By Investing.com
events.summary: AJB Investment Fund II, a 10% owner of Jewett Cameron Trading Co Ltd (NASDAQ:JCTC), recently purchased $17,150 worth of the company's common stock. These transactions, occurring between September 10 and September 14, 2026, increased their beneficial ownership to 491,300 shares. The stock has seen a 66% return over the past six months.

articles.headline: AJB Investment Fund II acquires $17,150 of Jewett Cameron Trading stock By Investing.com

events.title: James Hardie Industries Issues 109 Unquoted Ordinary Shares Linked to AZEK Merger Equity Awards
events.summary: James Hardie Industries PLC has issued 109 unquoted ordinary shares (JHXAM) on September 10, 2026, priced at USD 0.6866, as part of the settlement of equity awards from its merger with The AZEK Company Inc. The merger was completed on July 1, 2025, and these shares are not intended to be quoted on the ASX. ASX granted a waiver from Listing Rule 2.4 for the issuance of these securities.

articles.headline: James Hardie Industries Issues 109 Unquoted Ordinary Shares Linked to AZEK Merger Equity Awards

events.title: Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy Pledge $1 Billion a Year to Virginia Suppliers
events.summary: Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy have committed to a supplier program worth up to $1 billion annually for Virginia businesses as part of a broader package aimed at easing regulatory review of their proposed merger. The package also includes monthly residential bill credits, a strengthened EnergyShare program for low-income households, and a workforce training fund, alongside commitments to maintain and create jobs in Virginia. These commitments are designed to address concerns raised by Virginia's regulatory bodies and Governor Abigail Spanberger regarding the merger's impact on household bills, employment, and clean energy investments.

articles.headline: Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy Pledge $1 Billion a Year to Virginia Suppliers

events.title: Raymond James Financial Issues Positive Forecast for Enbridge (TSE:ENB) Stock Price
events.summary: Raymond James Financial has increased its price target for Enbridge (TSE:ENB) from C$79.00 to C$80.00, maintaining a "market perform" rating and suggesting an 18.55% potential upside. Analyst consensus for Enbridge is a "Moderate Buy" with an average price target of C$77.62, despite the stock trading below its 50-day and 200-day moving averages. The company recently reported C$0.63 in quarterly EPS and C$29.32 billion in revenue.

articles.headline: Raymond James Financial Issues Positive Forecast for Enbridge (TSE:ENB) Stock Price
